content: Dear Customer, your SBI YONO KYC has expired today. Account will be blocked in 2 hours. Update PAN & Aadhaar immediately at http://sbi-kyc-verify-in.co/login
tip: Banks never send clickable SMS links or 2-hour account block threats for KYC updates.

content: MSEDCL Pune Alert: Your hostel/flat electricity meter will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM because your previous bill was not updated. Call Officer R. Sharma urgently on +91-98340XXXXX.
tip: MSEDCL never threatens same-night disconnection via personal mobile numbers; verify in the official Mahavitaran app.

content: India Post Customs: Your parcel #IN90412 is held at Mumbai Airport for unpaid ₹1,450 customs duty. Pay within 4 hours via bit.ly/ip-customs-pay or the parcel will be returned.
tip: Shortened bit.ly links and urgent ₹1,450 payment threats are classic fake courier customs scams.

content: Campus Part-Time Offer: Earn ₹3,500–₹6,000 daily from your hostel by liking YouTube videos & rating Google places! Pay ₹999 refundable training fee to join our Telegram HR group.
tip: Legitimate employers never ask students to pay a refundable deposit or join Telegram task groups.

content: Hi, I want to buy your used study table for ₹3,200. I've sent a ₹3,200 Collect Request on PhonePe—just tap Pay and enter your UPI PIN so the money enters your bank account!
tip: You only enter your UPI PIN to SEND money, never to receive a payment.

content: CONGRATS! Your mobile number won ₹15,00,000 in the Youth Digital Lucky Draw 2026! Transfer ₹2,500 GST processing fee via UPI before 6 PM today to release your prize.
tip: Real prizes and lotteries never ask winners to pay GST or processing fees upfront via UPI.

content: Incoming Call Transcript: 'Hello, calling from HDFC Fraud Desk. A ₹19,500 debit attempt is happening on your card right now. Read me the 6-digit OTP on your phone so I can block it.'
tip: Bank fraud teams never ask you to read an OTP aloud; sharing it completes the scammer's transaction.

content: SBI Alert: 482910 is your OTP for ₹420 payment at IRCTC. NEVER share this OTP with anyone, including bank staff. If not initiated by you, call 1800-1234 immediately.
tip: Genuine bank OTP messages include zero clickable links and explicitly warn you never to share the code.

content: Zero-CIBIL Hostel Loan: Get ₹25,000 in 3 minutes with just your college ID! Download RupeeFast_v2.apk directly from our link and grant Contacts, Call Log & Gallery permissions.
tip: Sideloaded .apk loan apps demanding Contacts & Gallery access harvest your data for extortion.

content: UPI AutoPay Notice: Your ₹149/month Spotify Student mandate renews on 20 Nov. No action needed. To pause or cancel before debit, open your own PhonePe/GPay app > Autopay.
tip: RBI mandates a 24-hour pre-debit notice with zero links—always manage subscriptions inside your official UPI app.

content: /src/assets/images/q_subscription_trap_1794895726415.jpg
tip: Tiny grey fine print hiding auto-renewal fees under a huge 'Free Trial' button is a classic money-leak dark pattern.

content: /src/assets/images/q_tampered_qr_1794895726460.jpg
tip: Check that no crooked sticker is pasted over the merchant QR standee and verify the payee name on your screen.

content: /src/assets/images/q_deepfake_video_call_1794895727368.jpg
tip: Blurring around the jawline and collar with mismatched lighting on an urgent video call signals a real-time deepfake.

content: /src/assets/images/q_campus_hackathon_poster_1794895727752.jpg
tip: Zoom into event flyers—garbled fine-print spelling and unverified bit.ly QR links reveal AI-generated fake posters.

content: /src/assets/images/q_upi_receipt_screen_1794895727984.jpg
tip: Fake payment screenshots often show misaligned digits or wrong currency symbols; verify credit inside your bank app.

content: /media/audio/q16_voice_clone_emergency.mp3
transcript: [Robotic cadence, flat room tone] 'Hey, it's me! My phone got stolen near Pune Station and I'm calling from a stranger's phone. Send ₹8,500 on this UPI ID right now, I'll explain later!'
tip: AI voice clones mimic panic and urgency; hang up and call your friend back directly on their saved number.

content: /media/audio/q17_digital_arrest_call.mp3
transcript: [Automated IVR voice] 'This is Telecom Regulatory Authority of India. Your mobile number will be disconnected in 2 hours due to an illegal parcel case. Press 1 to speak to Cyber Police.'
tip: Neither TRAI nor Indian Police conduct 'digital arrests' or settle cases over phone or video calls.

content: /media/audio/q18_real_placement_voicemail.mp3
transcript: [Natural office background] 'Hi, this is Priya from D. Y. Patil B-School Placement Cell. Tomorrow's analytics mock interview is shifted to Auditorium 2 at 10:30 AM. Check your official college ERP for details.'
tip: Official campus calls direct you to your verified college ERP portal and never ask for registration fees or OTPs.

content: /media/audio/q19_real_delivery_call.mp3
transcript: [Street ambient noise] 'Hello sir, I am standing at the D. Y. Patil B-School main gate with your Cash-on-Delivery book parcel. Please come collect it—no online advance payment needed.'
tip: Genuine Cash-on-Delivery couriers collect payment only in person upon handover, never via advance payment links.

content: /media/audio/q20_real_bank_ivr.mp3
transcript: [Clear toll-free IVR] 'Thank you for calling Axis Bank's toll-free helpline 1860-419-5555. Your lost debit card ending 4921 has been permanently blocked as requested. No OTP is required.'
tip: When YOU dial the official helpline from the back of your card, legitimate IVRs never ask for your PIN or CVV.
